facts.fact: Sinohydro was awarded the commercial contract in July 2022 (Presidential Order 226-K/22) to install 2,000 km of terrestrial fibre under the National Broadband Network (RNBL), financed by a China Eximbank loan (framework agreement January 2023, specific loan agreement signed October 2023); the record is a third-party database entry.

systems.owner: Government of Angola (MINTTICS); EPC contractor Sinohydro
